titleZh: UCAT 四模块与极限节奏起点复习笔记
titleEn: UCAT Four-Subtest and High-Speed Pacing Starting Review Notes
subtitleZh: 把 VR、DM、QR、SJT 的判断方法与计算器、标记、复查动作放进同一套执行系统。
subtitleEn: A practical starting system for VR, DM, QR, SJT, calculator use, flagging and review.
rightsNoticeEn: The current UCAT Test Format and Scoring, Test Tools page and 2026 Preparation Checklist are used only to verify question counts, timing, scoring boundaries, tools and the official preparation sequence. All bilingual explanations, methods, examples and active-recall prompts are independently written by Mantou; no official question bank, passage, scenario, option or explanation is copied or adapted. Official files and page snapshots remain in the internal research archive and cannot be downloaded here.
rightsNotice: 本笔记依据 UCAT Consortium 当前 Test Format and Scoring、Test Tools 页面与 2026 Preparation Checklist 核对题量、时长、计分边界、工具和官方准备顺序；双语解释、方法、例题和主动回忆均为满托独立创作，不复制或改写官方题库、文章、情境、选项或讲解。官方原件与网页快照只保存在内部研究区，不能从本站下载。

scope.includedZh: 覆盖 Verbal Reasoning、Decision Making、Quantitative Reasoning、Situational Judgement 和工具/节奏五个模块；包含 25 个知识单元、15 套方法、5 道满托原创逐步例题和 15 组主动回忆。
scope.includedEn: A five-module starting map for all four current UCAT subtests plus tools, navigation and high-speed pacing.
scope.remainingZh: 完成基础版后，按 VR、DM、QR、SJT 分模块进行限时题组，再进入四模块全卷；每轮只使用真实正确率、用时和错误类型调整训练，不把非官方换算或录取预测当作结论。
scope.remainingEn: After the Foundation Edition, complete timed sets in VR, DM, QR and SJT before moving to full four-subtest mocks. Adjust training from real accuracy, timing and error evidence rather than unofficial score conversions or admission predictions.

officialAnchors.title: UCAT Test Format and Scoring
officialAnchors.usedForEn: Used to verify the four current subtests, question counts, timing, skill objectives, score ranges, no-negative-marking rule and partial-credit rules in Decision Making and SJT.
officialAnchors.usedForZh: 核对四个当前模块、题量、时长、能力目标、计分范围、无倒扣、Decision Making 与 SJT 的部分得分规则。

officialAnchors.title: UCAT Test Tools
officialAnchors.usedForEn: Used to verify the operational boundaries of the QWERTY keyboard, mouse, erasable noteboard, shortcuts, basic onscreen calculator and Flag for Review.
officialAnchors.usedForZh: 核对 QWERTY 键盘、鼠标、可擦写草稿、快捷键、基础屏幕计算器与 Flag for Review 的操作边界。

officialAnchors.title: UCAT Preparation Checklist
officialAnchors.usedForEn: Used to verify the progressive sequence of Tour, Question Tutorials, Question Banks and Practice Tests, and that roughly 30 hours over six to eight weeks is guidance rather than a personal guarantee.
officialAnchors.usedForZh: 核对 Tour、Question Tutorials、Question Banks、Practice Tests 的渐进准备顺序，以及官方给出的约 30 小时、考前 6–8 周参考而非个人保证。

examFacts.valueZh: 当前考试由 VR、DM、QR 与 SJT 组成，每个模块前有单独计时的说明页。
examFacts.valueEn: The current test contains VR, DM, QR and SJT, each preceded by a separately timed instruction section.

examFacts.valueZh: VR：44 题 / 22 分钟；DM：35 题 / 37 分钟，DM 可使用基础屏幕计算器。
examFacts.valueEn: VR has 44 questions in 22 minutes; DM has 35 questions in 37 minutes and provides a basic onscreen calculator.

examFacts.valueZh: QR：36 题 / 26 分钟，可用基础计算器；SJT：69 题 / 26 分钟，不要求医疗流程知识。
examFacts.valueEn: QR has 36 questions in 26 minutes with a basic calculator; SJT has 69 questions in 26 minutes and does not require medical procedural knowledge.

examFacts.valueZh: 三项认知模块各为 300–900，总分 900–2700；SJT 为 Band 1–4。答错不倒扣，部分 DM 与 SJT 回答可获部分分。
examFacts.valueEn: Each cognitive subtest is scaled 300–900 for a 900–2700 total; SJT reports Bands 1–4. There is no negative marking and some DM/SJT responses receive partial credit.

examFacts.valueZh: 考场提供 QWERTY 键盘、鼠标、可擦写草稿；DM/QR 的计算器不含科学函数，并可使用导航、快捷键、标记和复查。
examFacts.valueEn: The test provides keyboard, mouse and erasable notes; the DM/QR calculator is basic, with navigation, shortcuts, flagging and review.

examFacts.valueZh: 先熟悉考试和 Tour，再看各模块 Tutorial，随后 Question Banks，最后在接近考试时做 Practice Tests。
examFacts.valueEn: Learn the format and Tour first, then subtest tutorials, question banks and finally practice tests nearer the test date.

curriculumBridges.statusZh: 基础知识多半已覆盖，速度与题型需专练
likelyCoveredEn: Mathematics transfers percentages, ratios, averages, graphs, probability and unit conversion to QR and DM.
English, History and Economics transfer evidence-led reading and argument evaluation to VR and DM.
likelyCoveredZh: 数学课程可迁移百分数、比例、平均数、图表、概率与单位换算到 QR/DM。
English、History、Economics 等课程可迁移证据阅读和论证判断到 VR/DM。
confirmEn: Whether VR decisions can use passage evidence only under roughly 30 seconds per question.
Whether QR decisions distinguish mental arithmetic, estimation and use of the basic calculator.
Whether SJT principles of patient safety, integrity, confidentiality, teamwork and timely escalation are understood without inventing clinical procedures.
confirmZh: 能否在 VR 约 30 秒/题的压力下只用文章证据判断。
能否在 QR 中判断何时心算、估算或调用基础计算器。
是否理解 SJT 的患者安全、诚信、保密、团队与及时升级原则，而不臆造医疗流程。
curriculumBridges.firstActionZh: 先用四套站内原创短诊断测每题用时和错因，再按最弱模块回到本页方法。
curriculumBridges.firstActionEn: Use the four original short diagnostics to measure time and error type, then return to the methods for the weakest subtest.

curriculumBridges.statusZh: 跨学科能力可迁移，极限节奏需重建
likelyCoveredEn: TOK, Language A and Group 3 subjects transfer claims, evidence, assumptions and information reliability.
IB Mathematics and Sciences transfer data, probability, units, estimation and graphs.
likelyCoveredZh: TOK、Language A 与 Group 3 科目可迁移 claim、evidence、assumption 和信息可靠性。
IB Mathematics 与 Sciences 可迁移数据、概率、单位、估算与图表。
confirmEn: Whether open-ended explanation can be replaced by the single answer supported by the material.
Whether stop-loss decisions can be executed across consecutive high-speed subtests instead of seeking certainty on every item.
Whether each SJT action can be evaluated through safety, authority, integrity, communication and escalation.
confirmZh: 能否从开放式解释切换到唯一被材料支持的答案。
能否在连续高速模块中执行止损，而不是追求每题完全确定。
能否把 SJT 的每个行动拆成安全、权限、诚信、沟通和升级五个维度。
curriculumBridges.firstActionZh: 先建立单题决策门槛，再用记录表观察错误来自理解、方法、操作还是时间。
curriculumBridges.firstActionEn: Set a decision threshold for each item, then record whether errors come from comprehension, method, interface operation or time.

curriculumBridges.statusZh: 阅读与数据基础可迁移，英式测试界面需适应
likelyCoveredEn: AP English Language and History transfer rapid reading, claims, evidence and qualification.
AP Statistics, Precalculus and Sciences transfer tables, ratios, probability and data interpretation.
likelyCoveredZh: AP English Language、History 可迁移快速阅读、主张、证据与限定判断。
AP Statistics、Precalculus 与 Sciences 可迁移表格、比例、概率和数据解释。
confirmEn: Whether True/False/Can't Tell, Yes/No statement sets and ranked SJT responses are familiar.
Whether the basic onscreen calculator and keyboard shortcuts can be used without relying on graphing or scientific functions.
Whether familiar US medical or school rules can be kept out of UK scenarios unless the prompt supports them.
confirmZh: 是否熟悉 True/False/Can’t Tell、Yes/No statement set 和 SJT 排序式响应。
是否能使用屏幕基础计算器与键盘快捷键，不依赖图形或科学函数。
是否能避免把熟悉的美国医疗/校园规则直接套入英国情境。
curriculumBridges.firstActionZh: 先完成工具与响应格式熟悉，再按 VR—DM—QR—SJT 顺序各做一个原创数据点。
curriculumBridges.firstActionEn: Learn the tools and response formats first, then collect one original data point in the order VR–DM–QR–SJT.

curriculumBridges.curriculum: 其他课程体系 / Other curricula
curriculumBridges.statusZh: 不要求特定学科组合，但基础与语言要逐项验证
likelyCoveredEn: Everyday English reading and school mathematics provide a starting point for VR and QR.
Experience of collaboration, integrity and safety can support SJT understanding, although SJT is not a medical-knowledge examination.
likelyCoveredZh: 日常英文阅读与学校数学可提供 VR、QR 的起点。
学校合作、诚信和安全经验可帮助理解 SJT，但不是医疗专业知识考试。
confirmEn: Whether fractions, percentages, ratios, averages, rates and unit conversions can be completed quickly.
Whether explicit support, direct contradiction and insufficient information can be distinguished.
Whether keyboard, mouse, calculator, flagging and review can be used continuously without losing pace.
confirmZh: 分数、百分数、比例、平均数、速率和单位换算是否能够快速完成。
能否区分文本明确支持、明确反对和信息不足。
能否连续使用键盘、鼠标、计算器、标记和复查而不丢失节奏。
curriculumBridges.firstActionZh: 先做不计分的工具演练，再用四模块短诊断定位知识、英语和操作中的真实缺口。
curriculumBridges.firstActionEn: Complete an unscored tool drill, then use the four short diagnostics to locate actual gaps in knowledge, English and operation.

modules.summaryEn: Answers come only from the passage. Speed comes from classifying the task and locating evidence, not translating every word more quickly.
modules.summaryZh: 答案只来自文章；速度来自先识别任务，再定位证据，而不是更快地逐字翻译。
learningOutcomesEn: Locate keywords, paraphrases and evidence according to the command in the stem.
Apply stable evidence thresholds for True, False and Can't Tell.
Reject options that exceed scope, change quantity or turn possibility into certainty.
learningOutcomes: 按题干任务定位关键词、同义改写和对应证据。
稳定区分 True、False 与 Can’t Tell 的证据门槛。
识别超出范围、偷换数量和把可能写成必然的选项。

methods.nameZh: 题干先分类，再决定阅读深度
methods.nameEn: Classify the task before choosing reading depth
methods.signalEn: Every question restarts at the first line of the passage, creating severe time pressure later in the subtest.
methods.signalZh: 每题都从文章第一行重新读，导致后半模块严重超时。
methods.methodEn: Classify the task as fact location, TFCT, main idea or inference. Search keywords and paraphrases for location tasks; inspect paragraph function and overall direction for main-idea tasks.
methods.methodZh: 先判断题目是定位事实、判断 TFCT、找主旨还是做推断；定位题先搜关键词和同义词，主旨题再看段落功能和整体方向。
methods.checkEn: Can you state whether this item needs one sentence, a comparison across two locations or the structure of the whole passage?
methods.checkZh: 你能说清这题需要一句证据、两处比较还是整篇结构吗？

methods.nameZh: 用三种证据状态判断 TFCT
methods.nameEn: Use three evidence states for TFCT
methods.signalEn: A statement absent from the passage is marked False, or common knowledge turns Can't Tell into True.
methods.signalZh: 你把“文章没说”当成 False，或用常识把 Can’t Tell 变成 True。
methods.methodEn: Direct textual support means True; direct conflict means False; neither support nor conflict means Can't Tell. Only passage evidence is admissible.
methods.methodZh: 文章直接支持为 True；文章直接冲突为 False；既不能支持也不能冲突为 Can’t Tell。只有文本证据参与判断。
methods.checkEn: Can you point to the supporting or contradicting sentence? If not, do not fill the gap with common knowledge.
methods.checkZh: 能否指出支持或冲突的原句？指出不了时，不要用常识补齐。

methods.nameZh: 逐项核对数量—对象—时间—强度
methods.nameEn: Check quantity, subject, time and strength
methods.signalEn: An option closely resembles the passage but changes all to some, past to future, or correlation to causation.
methods.signalZh: 选项与原文几乎一样，但换了 all/some、过去/未来或相关/导致。
methods.methodEn: Split the claim into who, how many, when, what happens and how strongly. Any changed cell requires fresh verification.
methods.methodZh: 把命题拆成谁、多少、何时、做什么、强度多大；任何一格改变都要重新验证。
methods.checkEn: Correlation does not entail causation, part does not entail all, and an observation does not entail a future prediction.
methods.checkZh: 相关不能自动变成因果，部分不能自动变成全部，观察不能自动变成未来预测。

originalWorkedExamples.titleZh: 满托原创例题：研究结果能否推出未来效果
originalWorkedExamples.titleEn: Mantou Original: Can a Study Result Support a Future Claim?
originalWorkedExamples.problemZh: 短文：一所学校试行延长图书馆开放时间四周。参与问卷的 120 名学生中，68% 表示更容易找到安静学习空间；研究没有测量考试成绩。判断：延长开放时间会提高所有学生下一次考试的成绩。
originalWorkedExamples.problemEn: A four-week school library trial found that 68% of 120 survey respondents found quiet study space more easily; exam results were not measured. Judge: Longer opening will improve every student's next exam score.

steps.bodyEn: The passage measures only reported experience of study space; it does not measure examination results.
steps.bodyZh: 文章只测量问卷中的学习空间体验，没有测考试成绩。

steps.bodyEn: The 120 survey respondents are not all students, and 68% is not everyone.
steps.bodyZh: 120 名问卷参与者不等于所有学生；68% 也不等于全部。

steps.labelZh: 第 3 步：拆时间与因果
steps.bodyEn: A four-week experience cannot establish future examination performance or a causal effect.
steps.bodyZh: 四周体验不能直接推出下一次考试成绩，更不能证明因果。

originalWorkedExamples.answerEn: Can't Tell. The passage provides no examination-result evidence and does not cover all students or future outcomes.
originalWorkedExamples.answerZh: Can’t Tell。文章没有提供考试成绩证据，也没有覆盖所有学生或未来结果。
originalWorkedExamples.trapEn: Choosing True because longer opening sounds helpful, or choosing False merely because the study has limitations.
originalWorkedExamples.trapZh: 因为延长开放听起来有帮助，就凭常识选 True；或因为研究不完善就错误地选 False。

activeRecall.promptZh: False 与 Can’t Tell 的关键区别是什么？
activeRecall.promptEn: What is the key difference between False and Can't Tell?
activeRecall.answerZh: False 需要文本明确冲突；Can’t Tell 是文本既不能支持也不能反驳。
activeRecall.answerEn: False needs textual contradiction; Can't Tell means the passage neither supports nor contradicts the claim.

activeRecall.promptZh: 定位题为什么要找同义词而不只找原词？
activeRecall.promptEn: Why search for paraphrases rather than only exact words?
activeRecall.answerZh: 题干和文章常用不同表达描述同一概念，只搜原词会漏掉真正证据。
activeRecall.answerEn: The task and passage often express the same concept differently, so exact-word search can miss the evidence.

activeRecall.promptZh: 每个命题要核对哪四个范围格？
activeRecall.promptEn: Which four scope boxes should every claim pass?
activeRecall.answerZh: 数量、对象、时间和强度/关系。
activeRecall.answerEn: Quantity, subject, time and strength or relationship.

modules.summaryEn: Convert verbal rules into checkable diagrams, tables or sets, then preserve the boundary of the conclusion when information is incomplete.
modules.summaryZh: 把语言规则转成可检查的图、表或集合，再在信息不完整时保持结论边界。
learningOutcomesEn: Convert ordering, grouping and deductive rules into a constraint table.
Use sets, Venn diagrams, probability trees or frequency tables instead of intuition.
Judge relevance and strength separately in strongest-argument and multiple-statement items.
learningOutcomes: 把排序、分组和演绎规则转成约束表。
使用集合、Venn 图、概率树或频数表避免凭直觉。
在 strongest argument 与多陈述题中逐项判断相关性和支持强度。

knowledgeUnits.labelZh: 最强论证与多陈述判断

methods.nameZh: 一句规则只写一个约束
methods.nameEn: Translate each rule into one constraint
methods.signalEn: Five or six ordering or grouping rules are held in memory and exceptions are repeatedly forgotten.
methods.signalZh: 你在脑中同时记五六条排序或分组规则，反复忘记例外。
methods.methodEn: Use arrows for order, brackets for grouping and crosses for mutual exclusion. Give each original rule one checkable symbol and record derived consequences separately.
methods.methodZh: 用箭头表示先后、括号表示同组、叉号表示互斥；每条规则只产生一个可检查符号，推导结果另行记录。
methods.checkEn: Does the final arrangement pass every original constraint rather than only the rules you remember?
methods.checkZh: 最终方案是否逐条通过原始约束，而不是只符合你记住的几条？

methods.signalEn: Conditional-probability wording is complex and the denominator population keeps changing.
methods.signalZh: 条件概率文字复杂，分母对象不断变化。
methods.methodEn: Choose a convenient total such as 100 or the actual population, draw a 2 × 2 table, fill intersections and margins, then identify the conditioned group explicitly.
methods.methodZh: 选一个方便总数（如 100 或题目实际人数）画 2×2 表，先填交集和边际，再明确问题的条件群体是谁。
methods.checkEn: Is the denominator the group described by among or given, rather than the whole population?
methods.checkZh: 分母是否是题目说的‘在……之中’，而不是全体？

methods.nameZh: 强论证要同时过相关、重要、直接三关
methods.nameEn: A strong argument must be relevant, important and direct
methods.signalEn: A reason sounds correct or emotionally compelling but does not answer the policy question directly.
methods.signalZh: 某理由听起来正确或有感情，但没有直接回答政策问题。
methods.methodEn: Check first whether it answers the question, then whether the impact is important, and finally whether the reason supports the conclusion directly. Background facts, extreme anecdotes and slogans are not strong arguments by themselves.
methods.methodZh: 先看是否回答题目，再看影响是否足够重要，最后看理由到结论是否直接；背景事实、极端个例和情绪口号不能单独构成强论证。
methods.checkEn: If the topic words are removed, could the reason fit almost any policy question? If so, it is probably too generic.
methods.checkZh: 如果删掉主题关键词，这个理由是否仍可套在任何问题上？若是，它可能太泛。

originalWorkedExamples.titleZh: 满托原创例题：五项培训的排序约束
originalWorkedExamples.titleEn: Mantou Original: Ordering Five Training Sessions
originalWorkedExamples.problemZh: 五项培训 A、B、C、D、E 排在周一到周五。A 在 C 前；B 紧接 D；E 不在周一；C 在周五。哪个安排可行？
originalWorkedExamples.problemEn: Five sessions A–E are scheduled Monday to Friday. A is before C; B immediately follows D; E is not Monday; C is Friday. Find a feasible order.

steps.bodyEn: C is Friday, so A must occupy one of Monday to Thursday.
steps.bodyZh: C 在周五，因此 A 只需位于周一至周四。

steps.labelZh: 第 2 步：放置 DB 连块
steps.bodyEn: B immediately follows D, so treat DB as a two-position block that cannot include Friday.
steps.bodyZh: B 紧接 D，所以把 DB 当作一个长度为 2 的块；不能占周五。

steps.labelEn: Check E and the remaining positions
steps.labelZh: 第 3 步：检查 E 与剩余位置
steps.bodyEn: If DB is Monday–Tuesday, E cannot be Monday and can be Wednesday or Thursday. Place A on Wednesday and E on Thursday.
steps.bodyZh: 若 DB 放周一周二，E 不能周一，只能周三或周四；令 A 周三、E 周四即可。

steps.bodyEn: The order D, B, A, E, C satisfies all four original rules.
steps.bodyZh: 顺序 D、B、A、E、C 同时满足四条规则。

originalWorkedExamples.trapEn: Reversing 'B immediately follows D', or checking only that A is before C while forgetting that E cannot be Monday.
originalWorkedExamples.trapZh: 把“B 紧接 D”读成 D 紧接 B，或只检查 A 在 C 前而忘记 E 不在周一。

activeRecall.promptZh: 排序题中为什么要把“紧接”视为连块？
activeRecall.promptEn: Why treat an immediate-follow rule as a block?
activeRecall.answerZh: 它把两个元素的相对顺序和距离同时固定，显著减少可放位置。
activeRecall.answerEn: It fixes both relative order and distance, sharply reducing possible placements.

activeRecall.promptZh: 条件概率题的分母由什么决定？
activeRecall.promptEn: What determines the denominator in a conditional probability?
activeRecall.answerZh: 由条件所限定的群体决定，而不是默认使用全体。
activeRecall.answerEn: The conditioning group determines the denominator, not the whole population by default.

activeRecall.promptZh: 强论证的三道检查是什么？
activeRecall.promptEn: What are the three checks for a strong argument?
activeRecall.answerZh: 相关、重要、直接支持结论。
activeRecall.answerEn: Relevant, important and directly supportive of the conclusion.

modules.summaryEn: Choose the model and units before choosing mental arithmetic, estimation or the calculator. Calculation is the final step, not the first.
modules.summaryZh: 先决定模型和单位，再决定心算、估算或计算器；计算只是最后一步。
learningOutcomesEn: Extract the correct rows, columns, time intervals and units from tables and charts.
Build models for percentages, ratios, rates, multi-step costs and weighted averages quickly.
Use estimation, order of magnitude and reverse calculation to check calculator output.
learningOutcomes: 从表格和图表中提取正确行列、时间区间和单位。
快速建立百分数、比例、速率、多步成本和加权平均模型。
用估算、数量级和反算检查计算器结果。

knowledgeUnits.labelZh: 心算、估算与计算器选择
knowledgeUnits.labelEn: Mental Maths, Estimation and Calculator Choice

methods.nameZh: 先写单位链，再按计算器
methods.nameEn: Write the unit chain before using the calculator
methods.signalEn: The entered numbers are correct, but the answer is wrong by a factor of 60, 100 or 1,000.
methods.signalZh: 数字都输入正确，答案却差 60、100 或 1000 倍。
methods.methodEn: Write the target unit to the right of the equals sign and cancel minutes against hours, grams against kilograms, or per-person against totals before entering numbers.
methods.methodZh: 把目标单位写在等号右边，用乘除逐步消去分钟/小时、克/千克、每人/总量；最后才输入数值。
methods.checkEn: Do units cancel like algebraic factors at every step, leaving exactly the unit requested?
methods.checkZh: 每一步单位能否像代数因子一样约掉，并留下题目要求的单位？

methods.nameZh: 区分百分数变化与百分点
methods.nameEn: Separate percentage change from percentage points
methods.signalEn: A proportion changes from 40% to 50% and the answer is immediately reported as a 10% increase.
methods.signalZh: 比例从 40% 变到 50%，你直接回答增加 10%。
methods.methodEn: Percentage-point change is direct subtraction; percentage change divides the difference by the original value. Identify whether the stem asks by what percentage or how many percentage points.
methods.methodZh: 百分点是直接相减；百分数变化用差值除以原值。写下题干问 change by what percentage 还是 how many percentage points。
methods.checkEn: Is the denominator for percentage change always the original value?
methods.checkZh: 百分数变化的分母是否始终是原值？

methods.nameEn: Estimate the magnitude before exact calculation
methods.signalEn: The calculator returns a precise number, but there is no sense of whether the decimal point or option is plausible.
methods.signalZh: 计算器给出一个精确数字，但你无法判断小数点或选项是否合理。
methods.methodEn: Round key values to one significant figure and estimate a range first. If the exact result falls outside it, check units, brackets and the denominator before anything else.
methods.methodZh: 把关键数值取一位有效数字，先估结果范围；精算后若越界，优先检查单位、括号和分母。
methods.checkEn: Does the selected option lie within the estimated range and match the size relation in the context?
methods.checkZh: 正确选项是否落在估算区间，并与题目情境的大小关系一致？

originalWorkedExamples.titleZh: 满托原创例题：诊所库存的百分数变化
originalWorkedExamples.titleEn: Mantou Original: Percentage Change in Clinic Stock
originalWorkedExamples.problemZh: 某物资周一有 480 件，周内使用 135 件，又补充 75 件。周末库存相对周一减少了百分之多少？
originalWorkedExamples.problemEn: A clinic has 480 units on Monday, uses 135 and receives 75. By what percentage has weekend stock decreased from Monday?

steps.bodyEn: Subtract the units used and add the delivery: 480 − 135 + 75 = 420 units.
The decrease from the original stock is 480 − 420 = 60 units.

originalWorkedExamples.answerEn: Weekend stock is 12.5% lower than Monday stock.
originalWorkedExamples.trapEn: Using 135 ÷ 480 and ignoring the delivery, or using 60 ÷ 420 with the new value as the denominator.
originalWorkedExamples.trapZh: 只用 135÷480 忽略补充量，或用 60÷420 把新值当作百分数变化的分母。

activeRecall.promptZh: 百分数变化为什么除以原值？
activeRecall.promptEn: Why does percentage change divide by the original value?
activeRecall.answerZh: 它表示变化量相对于出发基准占多少，因此基准必须是原值。
activeRecall.answerEn: It measures the change relative to the starting baseline, so the denominator is the original value.

activeRecall.answerZh: 几乎每个多步或单位复杂题都应先锁定数量级，用来检查精算结果。
activeRecall.answerEn: Before most multi-step or unit-heavy calculations, to create a magnitude check for the exact result.

activeRecall.promptZh: QR 中最常见的三类计算器错误是什么？
activeRecall.promptEn: What are three common calculator errors in QR?
activeRecall.answerZh: 括号/运算顺序、单位未换算、分母选错。
activeRecall.answerEn: Brackets or order of operations, unconverted units and the wrong denominator.

modules.summaryEn: The task is not to memorise clinical procedures. Evaluate how an action affects safety, integrity, confidentiality, teamwork and timely escalation.
modules.summaryZh: 不是背医疗流程，而是判断行动如何影响安全、诚信、保密、团队和及时升级。
learningOutcomesEn: Separate immediate risk, role authority and information boundaries within a scenario.
Prioritise actions that protect safety, preserve integrity and place the issue with an appropriate person.
Distinguish whether an action is appropriate from how important it is to resolving the problem.
learningOutcomes: 把情境中的即时风险、角色权限和信息边界分开。
优先选择保护安全、保持诚信并由合适人员处理问题的行动。
区分行动本身是否合适与它对解决问题的重要性。

knowledgeUnits.labelZh: 尊重、团队与建设性沟通

methods.signalEn: An action is judged by whether the person means well rather than by its actual consequences.
methods.signalZh: 你凭“这个人是否好心”判断行动，而忽略实际后果。
methods.methodEn: Check safety, integrity, confidentiality, respect or teamwork, and role authority in turn. Address and escalate any serious immediate safety risk first.
methods.methodZh: 依次检查安全、诚信、保密、尊重/团队和角色权限；任何重大即时安全风险先处理并升级。
methods.checkEn: Does the action reduce a real risk rather than merely avoid conflict or make someone feel comfortable?
methods.checkZh: 行动是否降低真实风险，而不仅让当事人感觉舒服或避免冲突？

methods.signalEn: Seeking help or warning a team appears to require sharing identifiable information with uninvolved people.
methods.signalZh: 为了求助或提醒团队，你准备向无关人员分享可识别信息。
methods.methodEn: Ask who has a legitimate responsibility, what minimum information is needed and whether a more private channel exists. Even a safety exception should disclose to the appropriate person.
methods.methodZh: 先问谁有正当职责、解决问题需要哪些最少信息、是否有更私密的沟通渠道；安全例外也应向合适人员披露。
methods.checkEn: Does the recipient have authority and ability to act, and is any information beyond what resolution requires being shared?
methods.checkZh: 接收者是否有权限和行动能力？信息是否超过解决问题所需？

methods.nameZh: 先直接沟通，再按风险升级
methods.nameEn: Communicate directly, then escalate by risk
methods.signalEn: The apparent choice is between saying nothing and making the highest-level complaint immediately.
methods.signalZh: 你在“什么都不说”和“立即最高级投诉”之间二选一。
methods.methodEn: When there is no immediate danger and direct discussion is appropriate, address the issue privately, specifically and respectfully. Escalate promptly when risk is serious, behaviour persists, integrity or safety is involved, or the issue exceeds your role.
methods.methodZh: 若无即时危险且适合直接沟通，先私下、具体、尊重地处理；若风险重大、行为持续、涉及诚信/安全或超出权限，及时找合适上级。
methods.checkEn: Is the escalation proportionate to the risk, and has concern about awkwardness delayed a safety response?
methods.checkZh: 升级层级与风险是否相称，并且没有因怕尴尬而延误安全处理？

originalWorkedExamples.titleZh: 满托原创例题：共享登录信息的合适行动
originalWorkedExamples.titleEn: Mantou Original: Responding to Shared Login Details
originalWorkedExamples.problemZh: 你在志愿者值班时发现同伴把系统登录信息写在公共白板上，称这样换班更方便。最合适的第一步是什么？
originalWorkedExamples.problemEn: During a volunteer shift, a colleague writes shared system login details on a public whiteboard for convenience. What is the most appropriate first response?

steps.bodyEn: Public credentials create unauthorised access, unclear record ownership and privacy risk; this is not merely a tidiness issue.
steps.bodyZh: 公开凭证带来未授权访问、记录归属不清和隐私风险，不是单纯的整洁问题。

steps.labelZh: 第 2 步：采取即时最小行动
steps.bodyEn: Remove or cover the exposed credentials to prevent further risk, and do not use the shared account.
steps.bodyZh: 先移除或遮住暴露的凭证，避免风险继续扩大；不要使用该共享账号。

steps.bodyEn: Explain the reason privately to the colleague and notify the responsible person through the organisation's channel so credentials can be replaced and individual access provided.
steps.bodyZh: 私下向同伴说明原因，并按组织渠道告知负责人员，以便更换凭证和提供个人访问方式。

originalWorkedExamples.answerEn: Stop further exposure immediately, do not use the shared login, explain the concern to the colleague and report through the appropriate channel so the credentials can be replaced.
originalWorkedExamples.answerZh: 立即停止凭证继续暴露，避免使用共享登录，并向同伴说明后按合适渠道报告以更换凭证。
originalWorkedExamples.trapEn: Ignoring the issue to preserve the relationship, or photographing the credentials and posting them to a large group, expanding the breach.
originalWorkedExamples.trapZh: 为了保持关系而忽略，或把凭证拍照发到大群提醒所有人，从而再次扩大泄露。

activeRecall.promptZh: SJT 的五维风险扫描包含什么？
activeRecall.promptEn: What are the five dimensions in the SJT risk scan?
activeRecall.answerZh: 安全、诚信、保密、尊重/团队、角色权限与升级。
activeRecall.answerEn: Safety, integrity, confidentiality, respect or teamwork, and role boundaries or escalation.

activeRecall.answerZh: 只向有正当职责和行动能力的人，分享解决问题所必需的信息。
activeRecall.answerEn: Share only the information needed to solve the problem with people who have a legitimate role and ability to act.

activeRecall.promptZh: 何时不应只靠直接沟通？
activeRecall.promptEn: When is direct communication alone insufficient?
activeRecall.answerZh: 存在即时或重大安全风险、诚信问题持续、超出本人权限，或当事人无法安全处理时。
activeRecall.answerEn: When risk is immediate or serious, integrity concerns persist, the matter exceeds your role, or direct handling is unsafe.

modules.summaryEn: Turn interface actions into low-load habits first, then use personal data to set different stop-loss points for each subtest.
modules.summaryZh: 先把界面动作练成肌肉记忆，再用数据设定每个模块不同的止损点。
learningOutcomesEn: Understand the operational limits of navigation, shortcuts, mouse, calculator and erasable notes.
Set passage-set, item-set or single-item checkpoints appropriate to each subtest.
Flag only items that can change through review and preserve time at the end to act on them.
learningOutcomes: 熟悉导航、快捷键、鼠标、计算器和可擦写草稿的功能边界。
按模块建立文章包、题组或单题进度检查点。
只标记真正可通过复查改变的题，并保留末段复查时间。

methods.nameZh: 工具训练与题目训练分开
methods.nameEn: Separate tool drills from question drills
methods.signalEn: The question is understood, but opening the calculator, switching between mouse and keyboard or navigating consumes substantial time.
methods.signalZh: 你理解题目，却因打开计算器、切换鼠标键盘或导航浪费大量时间。
methods.methodEn: Use trivial numbers and blank items to practise shortcuts, number entry, clearing, flagging, next-item navigation and review before adding genuine reasoning load.
methods.methodZh: 先用无难度数字和空白题单独练快捷键、数字输入、清除、标记、下一题与复查；动作稳定后再加入真实推理负荷。
methods.checkEn: Can common actions be completed without searching the interface, and do you know which actions require the mouse?
methods.checkZh: 你能否不思考界面位置就完成常用动作，并知道哪些动作必须使用鼠标？

methods.nameEn: Every flag needs a review reason
methods.signalEn: Every uncertain item is flagged, leaving a long list with no review priority.
methods.signalZh: 你把所有不确定题都标记，最后看到一长串但不知道先处理什么。
methods.methodEn: Write one letter when flagging: E for missing evidence, C for calculation, R for unchecked rule. Review only items most likely to change after new evidence or recalculation.
methods.methodZh: 标记时在草稿写一字母：E=缺证据、C=待计算、R=规则未验；复查只处理最可能因新证据或重算而改变的题。
methods.checkEn: Without a defined next action, the flag records anxiety rather than a review plan.
methods.checkZh: 如果没有明确的下一步动作，这个标记只是焦虑记录，不是复查计划。

methods.nameZh: 用模块数据设止损，不套统一秒数
methods.nameEn: Set stop-loss thresholds from subtest data
methods.signalEn: VR, DM, QR and SJT receive the same per-question time despite shared stimuli and different response complexity.
methods.signalZh: 你给 VR、DM、QR、SJT 每题相同时间，忽略题组共享材料与响应复杂度。
methods.methodEn: Record median time, 90th-percentile time and accuracy separately. Set checkpoints by passage set in VR, data set in QR, question family in DM and scenario set in SJT.
methods.methodZh: 分别记录每个模块的中位用时、90 分位用时和正确率；VR 按文章包、QR 按数据组、DM 按题型、SJT 按情境组设检查点。
methods.checkEn: Does each stop-loss point come from at least two practice datasets and preserve an executable review window?
methods.checkZh: 止损点是否来自至少两次练习数据，并为每个模块保留可执行的复查窗口？

originalWorkedExamples.titleZh: 满托原创例题：为 VR 建立文章包检查点
originalWorkedExamples.titleEn: Mantou Original: Building VR Passage Checkpoints
originalWorkedExamples.problemZh: VR 有 11 篇文章、22 分钟。你希望末尾保留 2 分钟处理标记题，如何建立简单检查点？
originalWorkedExamples.problemEn: VR has 11 passages in 22 minutes. You want to reserve two minutes for flagged questions. Build simple checkpoints.

steps.bodyEn: Twenty-two minus 2 leaves 20 minutes for 11 passages, or about 109 seconds per passage set.
steps.bodyZh: 22−2=20 分钟完成 11 篇，平均每篇文章包约 109 秒。

math.text: 22 minus 2 minutes, multiplied by 60 and divided by 11, is about 109 seconds

steps.labelZh: 第 2 步：设批次检查点
steps.bodyEn: Aim to finish 3 passages at about 5:30, 6 at 11:00, 9 at 16:30 and all 11 at 20:00.
steps.bodyZh: 约第 5 分 30 秒完成 3 篇、第 11 分钟完成 6 篇、第 16 分 30 秒完成 9 篇、第 20 分钟完成 11 篇。

steps.labelZh: 第 3 步：定义超时动作
steps.bodyEn: If a passage is clearly over time and produces no new evidence, keep the current answer, mark E and continue. Review from the evidence location at the end.
steps.bodyZh: 若一篇明显超时且没有新证据，保留当前答案、标 E 并进入下一篇；末尾按证据位置复查。

originalWorkedExamples.answerEn: Use 20 minutes for the first pass with checkpoints at roughly 3, 6, 9 and 11 passages, then spend 2 minutes only on flags with a defined review reason.
originalWorkedExamples.answerZh: 首轮 20 分钟，按约 3/6/9/11 篇设置检查点，末尾 2 分钟只处理有明确复查理由的标记题。
originalWorkedExamples.trapEn: Forcing 30 seconds on every question and ignoring shared passage-reading cost, or leaving no review time.
originalWorkedExamples.trapZh: 机械要求每题 30 秒而忽略同一文章的共享阅读成本，或完全不留复查时间。

activeRecall.promptZh: 为什么工具动作要先单独练？
activeRecall.promptEn: Why practise tool actions separately first?
activeRecall.answerZh: 这样能把界面操作变成低认知负荷动作，避免与推理同时争夺工作记忆。
activeRecall.answerEn: It turns interface use into a low-load habit so it does not compete with reasoning in working memory.

activeRecall.promptZh: 一个有效标记必须包含什么？
activeRecall.promptEn: What must an effective flag include?
activeRecall.answerZh: 明确的未决原因和复查时可执行的下一步动作。
activeRecall.answerEn: A clear unresolved reason and an actionable next step for review.

activeRecall.promptZh: 为什么四个模块不能共用一个单题止损秒数？
activeRecall.promptEn: Why not use one per-question stop-loss across all subtests?
activeRecall.answerZh: 题组共享材料、响应方式和计算负荷不同，应按模块和题型的数据设置。
activeRecall.answerEn: Shared stimuli, response formats and calculation load differ, so thresholds must use subtest- and type-specific data.

reviewWorkflow.actionEn: Record curriculum, English and mathematics foundations, experience in each subtest and weekly study time.
reviewWorkflow.actionZh: 记录课程体系、英语与数学基础、四模块经验和每周可用时间。

reviewWorkflow.stepZh: 先熟悉工具与响应格式
reviewWorkflow.actionEn: Practise navigation, calculator, keyboard, mouse, flagging and response submission without pursuing a score.
reviewWorkflow.actionZh: 在不追求分数的情况下练导航、计算器、键鼠、标记和各题型提交方式。

reviewWorkflow.actionEn: Record answers, time, answer changes, partial credit and error type separately for VR, DM, QR and SJT.
reviewWorkflow.actionZh: 分别记录 VR、DM、QR、SJT 的答案、用时、改答、部分得分和错因。

reviewWorkflow.actionEn: Separate gaps in knowledge, English, reasoning, operation and pacing, then build a reusable action for each question family.
reviewWorkflow.actionZh: 区分知识、英语、推理、操作和节奏缺口，再逐题型建立可复用动作。

reviewWorkflow.stepZh: 最后进入完整限时练习
reviewWorkflow.stepEn: Move to full timed practice last
reviewWorkflow.actionEn: Use a complete mock to test continuous execution only after methods and tool actions are stable across all four subtests.
reviewWorkflow.actionZh: 只有当四模块方法与工具动作稳定后，才使用完整模拟检验连续执行。
